data.name: Nooriyyah
data.gender_notes: Nooriyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nooriyyah means 'light of Allah' or 'radiance of God'. It symbolizes illumination and guidance. The name Nooriyyah carries the meaning “Light of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nooriyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody light of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, light (noor) is attributed to Allah, signifying guidance and wisdom. Nooriyyah embodies these divine qualities.
data.etymology: Nooriyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nooriyyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: نوریة
in_arabic.long_meaning: نوریة هو اسم علم مؤنث يعود إلى الجذر النور، ويحمل معنى الضياء وال照明، ويتعلق بالنور الإلهي في القرآن الكريم، وي象ز إلى النور والضياء في الحياة الروحية والدنيا

in_urdu.name: نوریہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوریہ ایک اسلامی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نور کی طرف سے، اور یہ نام عربوں کے جڑ سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے، جو روحانی زندگی اور دنیا کی روشنی کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: नूरिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: नूरिया एक मुस्लिम नाम है जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश की ओर से, और यह नाम अरबी जड़ से लिया गया है, जो आत्मा जीवन और दुनिया की रोशनी के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: نوريہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: نوريہ د يو اسلامي نوم دی چې معنی یې د نوري له خوا دی، او دا نوم عربي ریښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د روحاني ژوند او نړی د رڼا لپاره کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Nooriyyah
in_english.long_meaning: Nooriyyah is an Islamic name derived from Arabic roots, meaning light and illumination from God, and is associated with spiritual enlightenment and worldly guidance, and is considered a blessed name in Muslim tradition

pronunciation.urdu: نوریہ کا تلفظ نو ریہ ہے
pronunciation.pashto: نوريہ د تلفظ نو ریہ دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Nooriyyah is a beautiful Islamic name that holds significant cultural value. The name is often given to girls and reflects the deep connection many Muslims have with their faith. The name carries a sense of nobility, grace, and purity, which are all highly valued in Muslim culture. It is a reminder of the light of God and the importance of seeking knowledge and guidance from Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Nooriyyah represents the light and guidance of Allah. It is a reminder of the divine presence and the importance of striving to live a life that is in line withAllah's will. The name encourages one to seek knowledge and wisdom, to be a source of light and guidance for others, and to always remember the presence and guidance of Allah in their daily lives. It is a powerful reminder of the role of faith in guiding and illuminating our lives.
